code: For each edge (u -> v) with onset/terminus:   depart = max(arrival[u], onset)   if depart < terminus AND depart < arrival[v]:     arrival[v] = depart Repeat until no changes (handles non-DAG cycles).

title: Temporal Network Analysis Module — Build Spec
text: Input validation (8+ tests): missing columns, non-numeric times, terminus <= onset, NAs Chain topology (5+ tests): ->B->C->D->E known reachability, closeness, betweenness Star topology (5+ tests): hub reaches , leaves reach 1 Undirected (5+ tests): symmetric reachability, doubled edges BFS Edge dynamics (5+ tests): formation/dissolution counts, edge durations Burstiness (3+ tests): bursty data (B > 0), periodic data (B < 0), single-event vertices (NA) Snapshot metrics (10+ tests): density, transitivity, reciprocity, centralization per bin Node-level centralities (5+ tests): closeness, betweenness, eigenvector, PageRank per snapshot Large-scale (3+ tests): 100+ vertices, 1000+ edges – verify crashes, reasonable timing S3 methods (5+ tests): print, summary, plot (types return ggplot invisible) Proximity timeline (5+ tests): spline interpolation, interleaved slots, highlight, labels temporal_paths (5+ tests): BFS specific vertices, path tracing, unreachable vertices extract_snapshot (3+ tests): correct edges specific time points

title: Temporal Network Analysis Module — Build Spec
text: loops – use vapply, tapply, tabulate, vectorized ops. Exception: temporal BFS inner loop (unavoidable sequential dependency). igraph Suggests – core metrics (degree, reachability, burstiness, formation/dissolution, temporal density) must work without igraph. Snapshot-based metrics gracefully skip igraph unavailable. Base R preferred – tidyverse. ggplot2 plots (already Import). cograph_network compatible – $nodes, $edges, $directed, $meta fields follow cograph conventions. temporal_network class can passed cograph functions inspect fields. NEVER touch diagonals – zeroing, excluding, modifying diagonal entries matrix operation. CRAN-ready – @return tags exports, global variable warnings, _R_CHECK_LIMIT_CORES_ guard parallel code.

title: Temporal Network Analysis Module — Build Spec
text: output objects must include fields cograph compatibility: temporal_network: $weights NULL (single static matrix), $edges extra onset/terminus columns. $meta$temporal sub-list carries time metadata.

code: as_network_dynamic <- function(x) {   spells <- as.data.frame(x)   vertices <- as.data.frame(x, what = "nodes")   ids <- stats::setNames(seq_len(nrow(vertices)), vertices$name)   base <- network::network.initialize(length(ids), directed = TRUE)   nd <- networkDynamic::networkDynamic(     base.net = base,     edge.spells = data.frame(onset = spells$start, terminus = spells$end,                              tail = as.integer(ids[spells$from]),                              head = as.integer(ids[spells$to])),     verbose = FALSE   )   network::set.vertex.attribute(nd, "vertex.names", vertices$name)   nd } nd <- as_network_dynamic(dn) graph_agreement <- function(quantity, result, reference) {   measured <- as.data.frame(result)   reference <- as.numeric(reference)   stopifnot("the two series have different lengths" =               length(reference) == nrow(measured))   data.frame(quantity = quantity, compared = nrow(measured),              max_abs_difference = max(abs(measured$value - reference))) }  node_agreement <- function(quantity, result, reference) {   measured <- as.data.frame(result)   reference <- as.matrix(reference)   flat <- data.frame(     time = rep(sort(unique(measured$time)), times = ncol(reference)),     node = rep(colnames(reference), each = nrow(reference)),     reference = as.numeric(reference), stringsAsFactors = FALSE   )   both <- merge(measured, flat, by = c("time", "node"))   stopifnot("a node-day was lost in the join" = nrow(both) == nrow(measured))   data.frame(quantity = quantity, compared = nrow(both),              max_abs_difference = max(abs(both$value - both$reference))) }  arrival_agreement <- function(quantity, result, reference, vertices) {   measured <- as.data.frame(result)   theirs <- stats::setNames(reference$tdist, vertices)   mine <- stats::setNames(measured$latency, measured$node)   shared <- intersect(names(theirs)[is.finite(theirs)], names(mine))   data.frame(quantity = quantity, compared = length(shared),              max_abs_difference = max(abs(theirs[shared] - mine[shared]))) } participants <- network::network.vertex.names(nd)  aggregate_density <- metrics(dn, measure = "density", window = "all") mutual_series <- metrics(dn, measure = "mutual",                          start = 1, end = 73, step = 1, window = 1) degree_per_day <- dyn_centrality(dn, measure = "degree",                                  start = 1, end = 73, step = 1, window = 1) forward_from_444 <- paths(dn, from = "444")  their_density <- sna::gden(nd) their_mutual <- tsna::tSnaStats(nd, "mutuality", start = 1, end = 73,                                 time.interval = 1, aggregate.dur = 1) their_degree <- tsna::tSnaStats(nd, "degree", start = 1, end = 73,                                 time.interval = 1, aggregate.dur = 1,                                 cmode = "freeman") their_paths <- tsna::tPath(nd, v = match("444", participants), direction = "fwd")  agreement <- rbind(   graph_agreement("aggregate density", aggregate_density, their_density),   graph_agreement("mutual dyads per day", mutual_series, their_mutual),   node_agreement("degree per node per day", degree_per_day, their_degree),   arrival_agreement("earliest arrival time", forward_from_444, their_paths,                     participants) ) knitr::kable(agreement,              caption = "Dynet against tsna and sna on the same network.")

title: Function catalogue
text: Eight verbs measure network time. returns dynet_metric: tidy data frame whose columns ordered session, time, unit observation, measure value. session column appears sessions = "separate", one mode keeps session labels apart. grid arguments shared eight. dyn_centrality(), metrics(), mixing() similarity() take four; dyn_reachability() pshifts() take start end ; burstiness() durations() summarise whole observed period. dyn_centrality() computes vertex centrality. takes one measure names scope, returns one row per vertex, time point measure. Nineteen measures available scope = "snapshot", treats time bin static graph, four scope = "temporal", measures along time-respecting paths reports time column whole window yields one value per vertex. dyn_reachability() computes much network vertex can reach. takes direction measure name returns one row per vertex per measure node level. Proportions labelled forward_reach backward_reach, counts forward_reach_count backward_reach_count. vertex excluded reachable set. metrics() computes graph-level structure. takes one forty measure names returns one row per time point measure. measure "triads" contributes sixteen rows per time point, one per triad class. mixing() computes much tie activity runs within vertex groups. takes name node attribute returns one row per time point ordered group pair, from_group to_group naming pair. pshifts() classifies consecutive turns Gibson’s thirteen participation-shift types. takes directed network output shape, returns dynet_pshifts data frame. output = "final" thirteen rows, one per shift class, always thirteen even class never occurred. "cumulative" thirteen rows per classified turn, carrying running count. burstiness() measures unevenly vertex’s events spaced. takes measure name returns one row per vertex measure, time column. burstiness coefficient 1 bursty limit, 0 Poisson reference -1 perfectly regular activity; memory lag-1 correlation consecutive inter-event gaps. durations() measures long relationships lasted. takes unit selects row identity measure name, returns edge-level table unit = "pair" "spell", node-level table vertex-activity units. censored argument decides whether spells whose boundaries never observed retained. similarity() compares network pair time points. takes coefficient name returns dynet_similarity data frame one row per ordered pair time bins columns time, , measure value. diagonal included one every coefficient except "hamming", identical layers differ nothing score zero.
